sql:
SELECT
    d.NorthAmericaSeason,
    avg(daily_sales) AS avg_daily_sales
FROM (
    SELECT
        f.DateKey,
        d.NorthAmericaSeason,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS daily_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY f.DateKey, d.NorthAmericaSeason
) sub
JOIN retail.DimDate d ON sub.NorthAmericaSeason = d.NorthAmericaSeason
GROUP BY d.NorthAmericaSeason
ORDER BY avg_daily_sales DESC
LIMIT 1
